title: Lock-Horizon Part of the Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge
content:
**Lock-horizon part of the Appraisal Order update visit charge.**

The lock-horizon part of the update visit charge reads the expiration date of the locked rate lock on the same loan file and counts calendar days from today to that date: 0 to 7 days adds the report type's rush fee, 8 to 14 days adds 50 percent of that rush fee, and a later expiration, an expired date or no locked rate lock adds nothing. The rate lock read is the Rate Lock Commitment on the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports whose status is locked, and its current expiration date. Half the rush fee is kept to the cent. The lock-horizon part is added into the standard update charge. The lock-horizon part is a turn-time premium inside the update visit charge; it is not a rush charge on the order, which is still charged only when the borrower asks for rush at order.

| Days from today to the lock's expiration date | Adds |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | The report type's rush fee |
| 8 to 14 | 50 percent of the report type's rush fee |
| 15 or more | Nothing |
| Expiration date already passed | Nothing |
| No Rate Lock Commitment in locked status on the file | Nothing |

**By report type (US dollars).**

| Report type | Rush fee (0 to 7 days) | 50 percent of rush fee (8 to 14 days) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 100.00 | 50.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 200.00 | 100.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 250.00 | 125.00 |

*Hypothetical:* a Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) order whose loan file has a locked Rate Lock Commitment expiring 7 days from today adds 150.00; expiring 8 days from today, 75.00; expiring today (0 days), 150.00; expiring 15 days from today, nothing.
